name: contract-law
description: Reviews supplier agreements and NDAs against playbooks, tracks renewals, and delivers business-readable risk summaries.

displayDescription.zh: 按审查剧本逐条审查供应商协议与 NDA，追踪续约与期限风险，并输出业务可直接阅读的风险摘要。
displayDescription.en: Reviews supplier agreements and NDAs against playbooks, tracks renewals, and delivers business-readable risk summaries.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按我们的剧本审这份 SaaS 协议，标出红线条款并给出业务可读摘要。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Review this SaaS agreement against our playbook and flag red-line clauses with a business-readable summary.

quickPrompts.zh: 按我们的剧本审这份 SaaS 协议，标出红线条款并给出业务可读摘要。
quickPrompts.en: Review this SaaS agreement against our playbook and flag red-line clauses with a business-readable summary.

quickPrompts.zh: 这份 NDA 是绿黄红哪一级？依据是什么？
quickPrompts.en: Is this NDA green, yellow or red? Give me the reasoning.

quickPrompts.zh: 列出未来 90 天内需要续约或发通知的协议。
quickPrompts.en: List agreements needing renewal or notice within 90 days.
